svg.title: AI Agent Loop — Two-tone icons
svg.desc: Six stages in sequence: Reason, Plan, Act, Observe, Evaluate, Repeat. Repeat connects back to Reason. Read the upper row from left to right, then the lower row from right to left.
svg.text: Reason → Plan → Act → Observe → Evaluate → Repeat
Use each result to inform the next iteration.
Six stage icons · One repeatable cycle
